fnol_text: My name is Felix Whitfield and I live at 755 Alder Lane, Milton, VT 05445. You can reach me on (555) 948-8736 or felix.whitfield@example.com. I was stopped at lights on 20 July 2025 when the car behind, driven by Ines Moreau, went into the back of mine. Rear bumper and boot are badly damaged. Policy MT-2025-00046. I'd like to claim for the damage to my car.

adjuster_notes.text: Called Dr Whitfield on (555) 948-8736 to acknowledge the claim. Felix confirmed the loss date as 20 July 2025.
Vehicle inspected at the repairer. Witness Noor Kaminski gave a statement by phone.
Third-party driver Ines Moreau reports a sprained ankle and attended County General. Felix reports bruised ribs.
